enchantments.tooltip: Toughness: While equipped this item grants 20 additional hitpoints. This stacks with all bonuses except for other items bearing the Toughness enchantment.
Arcane Casting Dexterity: This ability reduces the arcane spell failure chance by -10%.
Seeker +10: Provides a +10 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +10 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Use Magic Device +5: Passive: +5 Competence bonus to the Use Magic Device skill.
